title: Comic localization / manga-translator-ui project JSON adapter: docs-only interoperability candidate
observations: Upstream documentation describes project JSON with editable regions and optional exported translations; the P5.4 converter uses the documented structure.
Generated synthetic fixtures and CLI unit tests check only mapping integrity, not real project version compatibility or semantic quality.
The adapter is read-only, but privacy of the third-party software and any configured translator must be tested separately.
scope: Official documentation plus synthetic-format tests only; hands-on model/GUI/real-upstream-export checks not_run.
